sections.title: Pack

fields.label: Cells in series
fields.hint: How many cells the pack has. Everything the autopilot decides about the battery is per cell, so this is the one number that must be right.

fields.label: Capacity
fields.hint: The pack's rated capacity. -1 leaves the autopilot with no capacity figure, which is why its own remaining estimate can only ever be a voltage reading.

fields.label: Full cell voltage
fields.hint: Resting voltage of one fully charged cell. 4.05 V is the PX4 default for LiPo, 4.2 V is the charger's.

fields.label: Empty cell voltage
fields.hint: Resting voltage of one cell at 0% remaining. This is the landing decision, not the cell's datasheet minimum.

fields.label: Load drop allowance
fields.hint: How far one cell is expected to sag at full throttle. Used to keep a hard climb from reading as an empty pack.

fields.label: Internal resistance
fields.hint: Measured pack resistance, used to correct voltage back to rest. -1 lets PX4 fall back to the load-drop figure above.

sections.hint: What is plugged in. The cell count is the number to get right first: every other figure here is per cell.

sections.title: Measurement

fields.label: Measured by
fields.hint: Where voltage and current are read from.

fields.label: Voltage divider
fields.hint: The board's voltage divider. Calibrate it against a meter on the pack: a divider that is 3% out is 3% of every reading on this page.

fields.label: Amps per volt
fields.hint: The power module's current scaling, from its datasheet or measured against a clamp meter.

fields.label: Voltage ADC channel
fields.hint: -1 uses the board default.

fields.label: Current ADC channel
fields.hint: -1 uses the board default.

sections.hint: How the autopilot reads the pack. Calibrate the divider against a meter before trusting anything above.

sections.title: Low-battery levels

fields.label: Low level
fields.hint: Remaining capacity, 0-1, at which the low-battery action fires. 0.15 is 15%.

fields.label: Average current
fields.hint: The current PX4 assumes when it has nothing better, which is what its remaining-time figure is built on.

sections.hint: A fraction of the pack, not a voltage. What happens when one of these is crossed is the low-battery action on Safety & Sensors.
